column.name: metadata
column.Comment: 元数据（如模型参数、场景配置等）

column.name: message_type
column.Comment: 消息类型: SYSTEM, USER, ASSISTANT

column.name: type
column.Comment: 指标类型: blood_pressure(血压), blood_sugar(血糖), weight(体重), heart_rate(心率)

column.name: systolic
column.Comment: 收缩压 (仅血压类型使用)

column.name: diastolic
column.Comment: 舒张压 (仅血压类型使用)

column.name: value
column.Comment: 通用数值 (血糖、体重、心率等使用)

column.name: meal_type
column.Comment: 用餐类型 (仅血糖类型使用): 空腹、餐后1小时、餐后2小时、睡前

column.name: challenge_type
column.Comment: 挑战类型：运动/饮食/睡眠/用药

column.name: challenge_id
column.Comment: 挑战ID，可为空表示普通打卡

column.name: checkin_type
column.Comment: 打卡类型：运动/饮食/睡眠/用药

column.name: reply_to_id
column.Comment: 回复给谁的ID，0表示回复帖子

column.name: category
column.Comment: 分类：经验分享/求助问答/病友日记/健康资讯

column.name: disease_tag
column.Comment: 疾病标签：高血压/糖尿病等

column.name: category
column.Comment: 分类：早餐、午餐、晚餐、小吃、甜点

column.name: urgency_level
column.Comment: 紧急程度: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT

column.name: service_plan
column.Comment: 服务套餐: BASIC, STANDARD, PREMIUM

column.name: emotion
column.Comment: 情感识别：开心/难过/焦虑/平静

column.name: health_level
column.Comment: 健康等级：优秀/良好/一般/较差

column.name: plan_type
column.Comment: 计划类型：饮食/运动/睡眠/用药/综合

column.name: status
column.Comment: 状态：进行中/已完成/已暂停/已取消

column.name: enterprise_id
column.Comment: 企业客户ID(如果是企业员工)

column.name: risk_level
column.Comment: 风险等级: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL

column.name: indicator_type
column.Comment: 指标类型：血压/血糖/体重/心率等

column.name: trend_direction
column.Comment: 趋势方向：上升/下降/平稳/波动

column.name: warning_type
column.Comment: 预警类型：急性/慢性/预测性

column.name: warning_level
column.Comment: 预警级别：绿色/黄色/橙色/红色

column.name: organ_name
column.Comment: 器官名称（如：心脏、肝脏、肺）

column.name: interactive_points
column.Comment: 交互热点（可点击查看详情的位置）

column.name: level_code
column.Comment: 等级代码: FREE, STANDARD, PROFESSIONAL, ENTERPRISE

column.name: plan_type
column.Comment: 会员套餐类型: FREE, STANDARD, PROFESSIONAL, ENTERPRISE

column.name: status
column.Comment: 订阅状态: ACTIVE, EXPIRED, CANCELLED

column.name: payment_method
column.Comment: 支付方式: ALIPAY, WECHAT, BANK_CARD

column.name: payment_type
column.Comment: 支付类型: MONTHLY-月付, YEARLY-年付

column.name: payment_method
column.Comment: 支付方式: ALIPAY-支付宝, WECHAT-微信, BANK_CARD-银行卡

column.name: payment_status
column.Comment: 支付状态: PENDING-待支付, PAID-已支付, CANCELLED-已取消, REFUNDED-已退款

column.name: target_body_part
column.Comment: 目标部位（如：手臂、腿部、颈部）

column.name: role
column.Comment: 用户角色: USER-普通用户, ADMIN-管理员

column.name: member_level
column.Comment: 会员等级: FREE-免费版, STANDARD-标准版, PROFESSIONAL-专业版, ENTERPRISE-企业版

column.name: daily_quota
column.Comment: 每日使用配额(AI对话次数)

column.name: status
column.Comment: 账号状态: ACTIVE-正常, DISABLED-禁用, DELETED-已删除

column.name: level
column.Comment: 等级：1-青铜 2-白银 3-黄金 4-铂金 5-钻石

column.name: feature_type
column.Comment: 功能类型: AI_CHAT-AI对话, DIAGNOSIS-智能诊断, IMAGE_ANALYSIS-影像分析, SYMPTOM_CHECK-症状检查

column.name: suitable_for
column.Comment: 适用人群（如：焦虑、失眠、压力）

column.name: disease_type
column.Comment: 疾病类型（如：中风、骨折、运动损伤）

column.name: motion_data
column.Comment: 运动数据（关节角度、位移等）

column.name: rule_type
column.Comment: 规则类型：急性/慢性/预测性

column.name: indicator_type
column.Comment: 指标类型：血压/血糖/心率等

column.name: warning_level
column.Comment: 预警级别：绿色/黄色/橙色/红色

column.name: action_type
column.Comment: 预警动作：推送/电话/联系家人等

column.name: category
column.Comment: 分类：早餐、午餐、晚餐、小吃、甜点
